text: Colour, sound, and images are stored fundamentally differently from text.
explanation: All four are the same move: choose a set of things to distinguish, assign each a number, and store the numbers. A pixel is three numbers under an agreement about which is red; a sound sample is a number under an agreement about amplitude and rate; a character is a number under an agreement about which glyph. The differences are in the sampling and the compression, not in the kind of thing being done.
